Fortress 2.5Ltr Mid Grey Anti-Slip Decking Stain is a water-based solution designed for outdoor timber decking, providing robust protection and a modern finish. This stain is engineered to nourish and protect wood surfaces, making it ideal for patios, garden paths, and commercial outdoor areas requiring enhanced safety. The quick-drying formula is touch-dry in just two hours and recoatable in four, allowing for efficient project completion. Its water and UV-resistant properties ensure durability against the elements, extending the life of decking. With a coverage of 10m² per litre, this Mid Grey stain offers economical application and lasting appeal.
